description: Run one consolidation pass: among the 100 most recent episodes, each one with an emotional weight above 0.5 becomes a semantic fact — once, however often the pass runs. Working-memory slots lose relevance with age, and slots whose relevance has dropped to 0.01 or below are removed; that is the only deletion, and nothing in long-term memory is deleted. Run it between sessions or after a batch of zenbrain_store calls, not on every turn; compare zenbrain_health before and after to see the effect.
name: zenbrain_consolidate

decayed.description: Working-memory slots removed by decay (relevance at or below 0.01).

promoted.description: Episodes promoted to semantic facts in this pass.

pruned.description: Always 0: consolidation deletes nothing from long-term memory.

title: Consolidate memory
